summary: This document extends in-band signaling of Multipoint LDP (mLDP) so one message can cover many IP multicast trees using wildcards. This helps convert multicast trees into MPLS point-to-multipoint paths when they enter an MPLS domain, and back again at the edge.

eli5.summary: Instead of announcing each TV channel to the network one at a time, you can say all channels at once. That saves a lot of messages.
